description: Golden evaluation set for RAGuard. Ten starter cases spanning every corpus document, plus exact-identifier retrieval and one mandatory-abstention case. Target size for the dissertation is 50 to 100 cases; grow this file, never replace it, so that historical metric runs stay comparable.

schema.question: customer-phrased question
schema.ground_truth: reference answer used by Ragas answer-level metrics
schema.expected_sources: filenames that must appear in retrieved context
schema.expected_keywords: literal strings that must survive retrieval, typically identifiers and time windows
schema.should_abstain: true when the correct behaviour is refusal
schema.probes: what this case is designed to detect

cases.question: How long does a refund take to reach my credit card?
cases.ground_truth: Once the refund is approved, credit and debit card refunds are released in 5 to 7 business days. The clock starts when the returned item is scanned at the warehouse, not when it is posted.
cases.probes: baseline single-hop retrieval and faithful numeric reporting

cases.question: I bought a laptop three weeks ago, can I still return it?
cases.ground_truth: No. Electronics carry a 14-day return window under rule RT-014, which is shorter than the standard 30-day window, so a laptop bought three weeks ago falls outside it.
cases.probes: the model must apply the electronics exception rather than the 30-day default

cases.question: What does error PAY-402 mean at checkout?
cases.ground_truth: PAY-402 means insufficient funds. The customer should retry with another card or top up the account.
cases.probes: exact-identifier retrieval; dense-only retrieval typically confuses the PAY-4xx codes

cases.question: What evidence do I need to send for a damaged item claim?
cases.ground_truth: A damage claim requires at least three photographs showing the outer packaging, the damaged area, and the shipping label, plus the order number, the item serial number where present, and a short description of the damage.
cases.probes: list completeness; partial answers are a common failure here

cases.question: My parcel never turned up. When do you count it as actually lost?
cases.ground_truth: A domestic parcel is formally declared lost after 10 business days with no delivery scan, and an international parcel after 21 business days. The customer then chooses a replacement or a full refund, with no return required.
cases.probes: colloquial phrasing that does not match policy vocabulary; exercises query rewriting

cases.question: My AuraBrew X200 is showing E04, what should I do?
cases.ground_truth: E04 means a descale is required. Run the descale cycle with one cleaning tablet in a full tank, holding the two-cup button for 5 seconds. The cycle takes 18 minutes and must not be interrupted. Vinegar must not be used, as it voids the warranty.
cases.probes: error code lookup plus procedure retrieval from a second section of the same document

cases.question: Will you charge me a restocking fee if the appliance arrived damaged?
cases.ground_truth: No. Restocking fees are capped at 15 percent for opened large appliances, but they are never applied to items returned under the damaged-goods route.
cases.probes: negation handling; the retrieved passage contains both the fee and its exception

cases.question: I only noticed the damage after unboxing a few days later. Is it too late?
cases.ground_truth: No, provided it is reported within 7 calendar days of delivery. Concealed damage discovered after unboxing has a 7-day reporting window, while visible transit damage must be reported within 48 hours.
cases.probes: the model must select the concealed-damage window and not the 48-hour one

cases.question: Can I get a mortgage or a personal loan through your store?
cases.ground_truth: This is not covered by the available support policies. The correct behaviour is to abstain and direct the customer to a human agent.
cases.probes: abstention on an out-of-domain question; the corpus mentions payments and credit, which invites a plausible hallucination

cases.question: The espresso machine arrived cracked. Do I have to pay to send it back?
cases.ground_truth: No. Customers are never asked to pay return shipping for a validated damage claim. Visible transit damage must be reported within 48 hours of delivery, and the resolution options are a free replacement, a full refund including shipping, or a repair credit of up to 40 percent.
expected_keywords: never asked to pay return shipping
cases.probes: cross-document temptation; the Return Policy 4.99 GBP label fee is a plausible wrong answer
